contract: 계급 장식 3D (이미지 생성 1 45b6220, user OK): Halo / Horns rank r (Config.GetTitle) wears ServerStorage[Config.Visuals.MarkModels.Folder] Acc_HaloR<r> / Acc_HornsR<r> (a MeshPart, or a Model with one mesh) cloned, sized x head height / HeadRef (1.2), its bottom HaloGap (0.3) above / HornsDepth (0.06) into the head top (both x k), turned by Yaw, unanchored / massless / no collision, welded to the head; halos get the old PointLight, rank >= Glow.Rank (5) sparkles. A missing model keeps the drawn mark; the guild keeps its gear.
limitations: The import itself (GLB -> MeshPart in ServerStorage.MarkModels, the asset upload) and the real look on avatars (Yaw 0: the models were turned to face Roblox -Z before the import, 427baf8) are checked in Studio by game dev 1. CFrame is a translation + yaw stand-in (the test head never turns).
